messages:
sara-support: escalating. ACME reports objects that were deleted are now searchable again after we rolled a retention config back. They saw GETs return 404 yesterday then 200 this morning. Customer is worried about accidental re-exposure. workspace: acme-prod, sample object ids: obj_9f3a2, obj_b7c11, obj_c1e77. can eng + legal + obs take?

anika-cs: ack, on it. can you paste the customer timeline and the exact console actions they did?

sara-support: customer changed default retention from 90d -> 30d via console on 2026-03-09T03:11:40Z. we (support) reverted policy to 90d at 2026-03-09T03:50:12Z after they flagged errors. they report seeing deleted items reappear between 03:40-04:20 UTC. reproduction steps they gave: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/objects/obj_9f3a2` returned 404 at 03:30, then later returned 200 with JSON payload.

mike-sre: thanks. need the audit logs for policy-change events + indexer/deletion-queue status for those object ids. also, did we roll any infra changes around 03:4x?

harry-obs: searching infra events now. quick note: index rebuild job (retention-indexer v2) was rolled to region-us-east-1 in a staged deploy starting at 2026-03-09T03:44:00Z, completed ~03:48 UTC. I'll pull deploy bot logs.

leslie-legal: tagging in legal. important: if data was deleted and then re-exposed, we need to know if any exports occurred in the window. legal hold status? Any pending preservation?

sara-support: no legal hold on the workspace. customer did request an export at 2026-03-09T04:05Z (support ticket shows export requested). unclear if export completed. I'll attach support ticket ID 92471.

mike-sre: hypothesis: indexer rollout may have rehydrated metadata from a backup snapshot that didn't include tombstone markers (or applied tombstone->deleted state inconsistently). effect: object metadata becomes visible in search while underlying object storage still marks object as tombstoned. need: (1) metadata dump for object ids at 03:20, 03:40, 04:10 UTC; (2) deletion_queue entries for those ids; (3) storage path manifests and a read of the object's tombstone flag. commands to collect quickly: `psql -h obs-db -c "SELECT * FROM metadata WHERE object_id IN ('obj_9f3a2','obj_b7c11','obj_c1e77') AND ts >= '2026-03-09' ORDER BY ts;"` and `aws s3api get-object --bucket redwood-objects --key objects/obj_9f3a2/manifest.json ./manifest.json` (or equivalent). also need KMS audit id for any decrypts during export.

sara-support: pulled a couple quick items from support logs: deletion_queue shows obj_9f3a2 processed at 2026-03-09T03:18:02Z (status=processed), obj_b7c11 processed 03:19:10Z. index service logs show reindex job started 03:44:12Z and logged: `WARN tombstone missing for object obj_9f3a2, inserting placeholder`. attaching short excerpt: ```
[03:44:12Z] indexer-v2 INFO reindex-start region=us-east-1
[03:44:13Z] indexer-v2 WARN tombstone missing for object obj_9f3a2, inserting placeholder
[03:45:01Z] indexer-v2 INFO reindex-complete batch=1243
```

deploy-bot: deploy: retention-indexer v2 deployed to us-east-1 by jenkins-bot at 2026-03-09T03:45:01Z (:rocket:)

mike-sre: that log line is the smoking gun. the indexer insert of a placeholder without a tombstone flag would make the object visible to search even though deletion flow completed earlier. next steps: (A) create a metadata snapshot and storage check for the three objects (B) if storage still has tombstone, re-run index purge for those object ids to re-apply tombstone markers to the index (C) block any exports until we confirm no re-exposure. I will open a P0 internal incident and target a backfill re-purge job.

anika-cs: customer-facing ask: propose timeline to ACME. we should tell them: immediate block on exports, ETA for investigation 2h, remediation (index purge + verification) 6h, full audit package 24-48h. legal OK?

leslie-legal: preliminary: we cannot permit exports until we verify whether data was transiently visible. need a full audit dump (actions, KMS decrypt logs, s3 access logs, retention-policy-change event) for 2026-03-09T02:00Z -> 2026-03-09T05:00Z. once we have that, we'll advise communications & whether any notification is required.

sara-support: starting export now via support-export tool: `./support-export --workspace acme-prod --since 2026-03-09T02:00Z --until 2026-03-09T05:00Z --include=audit,kms,s3logs,policy-changes --out /tmp/acme-audit-92471.tar.gz` ETA ~2h. ticket 92471 updated.

mike-sre: created IN-4632, added links to the indexer rollout and logs. I'll run a targeted purge after audit snapshot completed. tagging @harry-obs to coordinate index purge job and @sara-support to confirm export completion.

sara-support: acknowledged. will update customer with the timeline and keep legal looped. :eyes:

leslie-legal: once export is ready, export to legal-s3 with KMS envelope so we have chain of custody. hold on external communication until we review.

mike-sre: final note — recommend a short mitigation: add a quick guard in indexer to skip inserting placeholder records for any object with processed deletion_queue entries within last 30 days. I'll follow up with a patch PR.
